messages.content:
Extract only information explicitly stated in the user request into the four listed fields.
Return exactly one JSON object: {"field_values": {<each field ID>: <string or null>}}.
Include every listed field and no other keys. Quote or faithfully summarize explicit requirements.
Use null when not stated. Do not infer a specific audience from a genre or infer a preference from silence.
An explicit statement of no preference/no requirement is resolved: preserve that statement as a string.
For required_content, a topic or genre alone is insufficient: specific required facts or literal phrases are needed.
For topics preserve exact topic names and any minimum times. Never invent dates, time limits or hidden answers.
No Markdown fences or commentary.

{"domain": "constrained_writing", "initial_request": "Write a friendly, welcoming notice for first-year university students about a workshop. The entire output, including any heading, must contain 55 to 75 words. Include these exact phrases: \"Study Skills Lab\", \"5 November 2026\", \"Room B12\", and \"register by 3 November 2026\".", "reference_date": "2026-11-01", "user_control": "continue", "fields": [{"field_id": "audience", "label_zh": "受众", "description_zh": "目标读者或收件人。不得凭体裁猜测具体受众。", "question_template": "Who is the intended audience?"}, {"field_id": "tone", "label_zh": "语气", "description_zh": "语气或明确无偏好。缺省语气不视为已提供。", "question_template": "What tone would you like?"}, {"field_id": "length", "label_zh": "长度", "description_zh": "全文英文词数范围或明确无长度要求。", "question_template": "What word-count range should the full text follow?"}, {"field_id": "required_content", "label_zh": "必含内容", "description_zh": "用户明确要求的具体事实或逐字内容。仅有主题或体裁不算已提供；明确无必含内容则算已解决。", "question_template": "What information or exact wording must the text include?"}]}
